userAnswers.essay:
In modern society, technological advancement has fundamentally transformed the ways in which people communicate and conduct business. While some argue that reliance on electronic devices degrades interpersonal relationships, I believe that digital connectivity brings profound economic and academic advantages when managed responsibly.

First, digital platforms eliminate geographical barriers...

comment: Clear position maintained throughout the essay. Well-structured paragraphs with relevant arguments. To reach Band 7+, incorporate greater grammatical complexity and varied sentence structures.
Balanced overall academic readiness. Listening and Reading demonstrate strong receptive skills, while active production in Writing and Speaking warrants continued timed practice.
